headlines.description: — Tage Thompson scored three times, including the 200th of his career, and added two assists in the Buffalo Sabres' 5-3 win over the Montreal Canadiens on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tage Thompson's 3-goal, 5-point outing leads Buffalo Sabres to 5-3 win over Montreal Canadiens

headlines.description: — Sidney Crosby scored one of Pittsburgh's three power-play goals and the Penguins beat the Philadelphia Flyers 6-3 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Crosby helps Penguins power past Flyers 6-3

events.name: San Jose Sharks at Washington Capitals

headlines.description: — Collin Graf and Pavol Regenda each had a goal and an assist and the San Jose Sharks used a three-goal second period to top the Washington Capitals 3-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sharks' 3-goal second period keys 3-2 victory over Capitals

events.name: Vancouver Canucks at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Kirill Marchenko and Kent Johnson each had a goal and an assist, leading the Columbus Blue Jackets over the skidding Vancouver Canucks 4-1 on Thursday night for their third straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Blue Jackets beat skidding Canucks 4-1 behind Marchenko and Johnson

headlines.description: — Marat Khusnutdinov and Viktor Arvidsson scored in the first 3:45 of the game, and the Boston Bruins held on to beat the Seattle Kraken 4-2 on Thursday night after
headlines.shortLinkText: After retiring Zdeno Chara's No. 33, Bruins get off to quick start and beat Kraken 4-2

headlines.description: — Mark Scheifele had a goal and three assists, Jonathan Toews scored for the fourth consecutive game and the Winnipeg Jets beat the Minnesota Wild 6-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Scheifele has 4 points as Jets beat Wild 6-2 for 4th straight win

headlines.description: — Mikael Backlund and Yegor Sharangovich each had a goal and an assist as the Calgary Flames beat the Chicago Blackhawks 3-1 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Backlund and Sharangovich lead Flames to 3-1 road win over Blackhawks

headlines.description: — John Marino scored at 4:03 of the third period to break a tie and give the Utah Mammoth a 2-1 victory over the Dallas Stars on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Marino scores in third period to give Utah Mammoth 2-1 win over Dallas Stars

events.name: New York Islanders at Edmonton Oilers

headlines.description: — Ilya Sorokin made 35 saves for his NHL-leading fifth shutout of the season, Anthony Duclair scored the game's only goal in the third period on the power play and the New York Islanders edged the Edmonton Oilers 1-0 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sorokin's NHL-leading fifth shutout and Duclair's late goal lift Islanders over Oilers 1-0

events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Vegas Golden Knights

headlines.description: — Jack Eichel scored at 2:44 of overtime, Mitch Marner had two assists against his former team and Adin Hill made 23 saves in his return as Vegas rallied to defeat the Toronto Maple Leafs 6-5 on Thursday night for the Golden Knights' sixth straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eichel scores in OT as Golden Knights rally to beat Maple Leafs 6-5
